briefdescription.para: Owned Poly value paired with its FreeAlgebra*, providing natural operator-overloaded arithmetic.

detaileddescription.para: Debugging / scripting convenience: wraps a Poly so the algebra pointer is implicit and +, -, *, unary -, and ^n (power) can be written directly. The destructor calls FreeAlgebra::clear, so callers do not have to manage the underlying Poly lifetime.
